messages:
Asha (PM): Quick sync — Customer Delta wants private deployment with 99.9% per-request SLA and ~50ms p95 for <128-token requests. Need to align product/eng/runtime/infra/security on feasibility + launch criteria. Who can take next steps?
Diego (Eng): Do we have expected steady-state QPS and typical seq lengths from Delta? That drives batching + slot sizing.
Asha (PM): Their initial expectation is 20 rps steady, 80rps peak in bursts. Mostly short queries (16–64 tokens) but some long ones occasionally.
Samir (Runtime): On model family: they're targeting a 13B opt-style open model. Benchmarks on A100 with 8-bit quant show p50 ~28ms, p95 ~78ms for seq64 with batch=8. With KV cache warm we saw p95 drop to ~42ms. We can hit 50ms p95 if we force prefix caching + adaptive batch caps. Need to validate with their prompt mix.
Priya (Infra): Capacity note — Dedicated carve for private deploy: we can reserve 4x A100s in us-west-2 for the pilot but need a minimum 30-day commit and billing approval. Cold start for new containers ~60–90s unless we prewarm. Also need to decide Dedicated vs on-prem (they asked about both).
Evelyn (Security): Security checklist: customer-managed KMS or HSM, audit log retention 13 months, data residency in us-west-2, and penetration test window. Also SOC2 evidence for pipeline. We need legal to confirm PII handling.
Megan (Product Ops): Proposed rollout: alpha (internal + 1 customer) -> pilot (Delta only) -> GA. Canary at 5% traffic, 1 week observation, automatic rollback on perf or quality regression. Can we define the canary guardrails? (latency, error rate, quality).
Diego (Eng): For guardrails: latency p95 <= 65ms, error rate <0.5%, semantic regression <= 2% on their eval prompts. I'll create a small harness: `ab-sim --qps 50 --seq 64 --trace` to reproduce.
Samir (Runtime): Quant caveat: int8 degrades some prompts — we must run a quality sweep on Delta's prompt set. Also provide two fallback models: quant-8 (cheap) and fp16 (expensive but higher quality). Routing policy should fallback to fp16 on failures.
Priya (Infra): On autoscale: we can enable burst capacity but need prewarming rules in the config. Suggest prewarm policy: `prewarm: maintain=2_gpus, burst=+2_for_5m` for pilot. Also need the PO and billing ticket by EOD Wed to lock the 30-day commit.
Evelyn (Security): Add to checklist: customer-managed keys (CKMS), audit streams to tenant-specific bucket with immutability flag, monthly log export for compliance. ETA for us to show a compliance plan? I need 5 business days to align with legal.
Asha (PM): Owner assign: Diego -> perf harness + canary guardrails (due Tue), Samir -> quant vs fp16 eval with Delta prompts (due Wed), Priya -> capacity commit & prewarm config + billing (due Wed), Evelyn -> compliance checklist + legal ask (due next Fri), Megan -> rollout doc + rollback steps (due Thu).
Diego (Eng): Ack. I'll post the harness repo link and test matrix when ready.
Samir (Runtime): Ack. I'll start with 200 sample prompts from Delta and run quality comparisons.
Priya (Infra): Ack. I'll open the PO ticket and tag @finance.
Evelyn (Security): Ack — blocking item: legal signoff on data residency. I'll surface that in legal thread.
Megan (Product Ops): I'll draft the alpha/pilot playbook and canary runbook, link it here.
Oncall-bot: NOTE: Scheduled maintenance window in us-west-2 on day+3; might overlap with pilot prewarm.
Asha (PM): Good catch on maintenance. Priya — can you confirm maintenance window impact by EOD so we can shift pilot if needed?
Priya (Infra): Will do; if maintenance conflicts we can shift pilot start by 48 hours.
Asha (PM): OK — thanks everyone. If no blockers, we'll treat these action items as the move-forward plan. Please add any concerns here.
Diego (Eng): One ask — can Product provide a prioritized prompt sample set (critical, common, edge)? That will speed quality eval.
Asha (PM): Yes — I'll upload a prioritized 100-prompt set by EOD.
Samir (Runtime): Perfect. I'll share initial results in this thread.
Megan (Product Ops): Adding a checklist item: monitor token costs during pilot and report daily.
Evelyn (Security): Also add: confirm audit log retention SLAs in contract.
Asha (PM): All acked? If so I'll kick off the tickets. :thumbsup:
Diego (Eng): :thumbsup: Ack.
Samir (Runtime): :+1:
Priya (Infra): Ack.
Evelyn (Security): Ack.
